第十四章 精神力与魔力（第1页）
数道不同的颜色微光从水晶球表面浮现，与此同时，一段简短的讯息，出现在塞恩脑海。
这不是塞恩第一次使用学院的公共水晶球，所以塞恩很清楚自己的关注重点在哪。
“精神力提升了37，魔力提升了26，就连体质也提升了12吗？”塞恩心里想到。
在半个多月前，出发前往咸水巨鳄的领地前，塞恩曾来图书馆测试过自己的精神力与魔力数值。
当时的数据分别是：精神力26，魔力255，体质76。
对于低级学徒的塞恩来讲，这份数据已经着实不错，难怪他敢冒着巨大的风险，去找咸水巨鳄的麻烦。
魔法学院对中级学徒的最低标准，是精神力达到30，如今塞恩的精神力卡在了297，标志着他距离中级学徒只差一步之遥。
至于魔力属性，往往是与魔法师们的精神力数值相挂钩，是储存于魔法师体内的一种基本能量。
譬如塞恩释放魔法时，他就是以精神力调动体内的魔力，从而将一个魔法完整的释放出来。
根据塞恩这么多年来在幽暗地域黑魔法学院的所学知识以及观察，他发现那些高高在上的正式黑魔法师们，对魔力这一数值似乎不怎么看重，反而更加在意的是精神力。
各个阶层的魔法学徒晋级，一般就是直接看精神力数值。
至少在塞恩目前的学识与眼界下，他认为魔力与精神力同等重要。
譬如塞恩释放一枚普通次级火球术，他所消耗的精神力和魔力均是10。
但他如果想释放一枚加强版的次级火球术，就是他之前干掉咸水巨鳄的那枚，就得需要10点精神力和15点魔力。
更多的魔力支出，标志着同一魔法最终爆发的威力将更大。
当然，两种次级火球术也是有些许不同的。
费学院积分，从公共图书馆兑换来的标准知识。

后者，则是塞恩通过研究火元素相关知识，以及协助莉娜实验时得到提点，从而自己稍作研究与改进的成果。
魔法的研究，不是一朝一夕就能完成。
塞恩的次级火球术，也根本称不上是一门崭新的魔法。
若是被其它正式魔法师看来，塞恩的成果不过是更改了细微的法术构建模型，从而使次级火球术能够乘载更多的魔力，因此威力才更大了一些，属于不入流的小玩意儿。
但就是这个不入流的小玩意儿，塞恩起码为之花费了近三年时间，这也使得他成功跻身于低级学徒中的佼佼者。
至于水晶球测试结果中的最后一项体质，则属于一般人都不会关注的东西。
根据公共课堂上讲解元素基础知识的魔法师们讲述，57点体质是一名壮年人类男子的平均体质。
塞恩今年16岁，还没有成年，但他的体质就已经达到88，超过了平均值，或许与他自幼掌握的那个粗浅呼吸法有关。

Chapter 14 Mental Power and Magic (Page 1)
Several shimmers of different colors emerged from the surface of the crystal ball, and at the same time, a brief message appeared in Thain's mind.
This isn't the first time Thain has used the academy's public crystal ball, so Thain knows where his focus is.
"The mental power has increased by 37, the magic power has increased by 26, and even the physical fitness has increased by 12?" Thain thought to himself.
More than half a month ago, before setting off to the territory of the saltwater giant crocodile, Thane came to the library to test his mental power and magic power.
The data at that time were: mental strength 26, magic power 255, and physical fitness 76.
For Thain, a low-level apprentice, this data is really good. No wonder he dares to take huge risks to trouble the saltwater giant crocodile.
The minimum standard for intermediate apprentices in the Magic Academy is a mental power of 30. Now Thain's mental power is stuck at 297, which means that he is only one step away from being an intermediate apprentice.
As for the magic attribute, it is often linked to the spiritual power value of magicians, and is a basic energy stored in the magician's body.
For example, when Thane releases magic, he uses his mental power to mobilize the magic in his body, thereby releasing a magic completely.
Based on Thain's knowledge and observations at the Black Magic Academy in the Underdark over the years, he found that those high-ranking formal black magicians did not seem to value the value of magic power very much, but instead cared more about mental power.
The promotion of magic apprentices at all levels usually depends directly on the spiritual power value.
At least with Thane's current knowledge and vision, he believes that magic and spiritual power are equally important.
For example, if Thane releases an ordinary secondary fireball, the mental power and magic power consumed by him are both 10.
But if he wants to release an enhanced version of the secondary fireball, the one he used to kill the giant saltwater crocodile before, he will need 10 points of mental power and 15 points of magic power.
More magic expenditure indicates that the final burst of the same magic will be more powerful.
Of course, the two secondary fireball techniques are also slightly different.
Fee college points can be exchanged for standard knowledge from the public library.
The latter is the result of Thain's own slight research and improvement through studying the knowledge related to the fire element and getting tips while assisting Lina in the experiment.
The study of magic cannot be completed overnight.
Thain's secondary fireball technique cannot be called a brand-new magic at all.
From the perspective of other formal magicians, Thain's achievement is just a slight change in the spell construction model, so that the secondary fireball spell can carry more magic power, so it is more powerful, and it is an inferior gadget.
But even with this low-level gadget, Thain spent at least nearly three years working on it, which also enabled him to successfully become the best among low-level apprentices.
As for the last physical fitness item in the crystal ball test results, it is something that most people will not pay attention to.
According to the magicians who taught basic knowledge of the elements in public classes, a 57-point constitution is the average constitution of a mature human man.
Thain is 16 years old this year and has not yet reached adulthood, but his physical fitness has already reached 88, which is higher than the average. This may be related to the shallow breathing method he has mastered since childhood.
